name: The Importance Of Church
overview: Scripture reveals the church as a divinely established body founded by Christ Himself, who promised that the gates of hell would not prevail against it (Matthew 16:18). Jesus, having all authority in heaven and on earth (Matthew 28:18), commissions His followers to make disciples of all nations, baptizing them into the triune name (Matthew 28:19). The early church devoted themselves to apostolic teaching, fellowship, prayer, and the breaking of bread (Acts 2:42), while leaders were appointed and entrusted with shepherding the church, which Christ purchased with His own blood (Acts 14:23; Acts 20:28). This underscores the church's vital role as a community of faith, teaching, and spiritual oversight under Christ's sovereign authority.
